description: CORRIDOR spine for the corridor + cores recipe (2D plan band, extruded `thickness` m in 3D as a thin coloured slab). Attach to a SPACE (the floorplate): `shape` picks horizontal (a run across the plate through the centre), vertical, cross (both, crossing at the centre), or l-shape (west arm + south arm meeting at the centre); each arm is `width` clear (default 2 m) and spans the host bounding box edge-to-edge automatically (detached fallback 24 m). `offset` slides each arm off the centreline perpendicular to its run (horizontal arm up/down, vertical arm left/right; + = toward +X/+Y i.e. right/down in plan; cross & l-shape move both arms, so the junction shifts diagonally). `clipInside` (default on) intersects the band with the host space polygon so nothing sticks outside a non-rectangular plate. Pair it with `floor_plate.v1` on the SAME space — give the plate `corrW` = this `width` and an `axis` matching an arm so its core row butts this corridor. Outputs: corridor area, width check.

vars._doc: Boxes extrude 0→thickness so the corridor reads as a thin coloured slab in 3D, and carry `clip: clipInside` so the band is intersected with the host polygon when the checkbox is on. Arms span the host bounding box (Lx across, Ly down); without a host both fall back to 24 m and the shape centres on the anchor. bcx/bcy = bbox centre; ocx/ocy = centre + offset (vertical arms sit at x=ocx, horizontal arms at y=ocy). hw = half width. l-shape = west arm (west edge → shifted centre) + south arm (shifted centre → south edge), overlapping width² at the corner. corrArea is bbox-analytic (subtracts the crossing/corner overlap; ignores clipping and off-plate overhang).
vars.corrArea: shape == 'horizontal' ? width * Lx : (shape == 'vertical' ? width * Ly : (shape == 'cross' ? width * Lx + width * Ly - width * width : width * max(0, hx + offset + hw) + width * max(0, hy - offset + hw) - width * width))
